gaps.lead: It took me two hours to assemble the wardrobe.
gaps.sentence: I ___ two hours assembling the wardrobe.
gaps.explanation: it took + time + to do = subject + spent + time + -ing.

gaps.lead: They say the new bridge will cut journey times in half.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ in half by the new bridge.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: journey times are said to be cut.

gaps.lead: I want to go somewhere where nobody knows me.
gaps.sentence: I want to go ___ nobody knows me.

gaps.lead: We couldn't find the museum anywhere.
gaps.explanation: Nowhere + auxiliary + subject: Nowhere could we find the museum.

gaps.lead: The painter worked for three weeks on the mural.
gaps.explanation: spend + time + -ing: spent over three weeks (working on it).

gaps.lead: Someone should test this water regularly.
gaps.explanation: should test → should be tested (modal + be + participle).
